Help provides help for any command in the application.
Simply type vcr help [path to command] for full details.

USAGE
  vcr help [command] [flags]

INHERITED FLAGS
      --api-key string            Vonage API key
      --api-secret string         Vonage API secret
      --config-file string        Path to config file (default is $HOME/.vcr-cli) (default "~/.vcr-cli")
      --graphql-endpoint string   Graphql endpoint used to fetch metadata
      --help                      Show help for command
      --region string             Vonage platform region
  -t, --timeout duration          Overall deadline for the command, including waiting for a build to finish (e.g. 20m) (default 10m0s)

LEARN MORE
  Use 'vcr <command> <subcommand> --help' for more information about a command.
